about: Words for the demo primer view (R-42). The server sends codes only; each code's text lives here. {skill} is filled with the skill's name from skill_map.json.

reasons.line_valid: The line checks out. Evidence for {skill}.
reasons.line_invalid: A wrong line in {skill}, with no known slip behind it.
reasons.slip_matched: The wrong line matches a known slip in {skill}.
reasons.probe_deeper: Missed that too. Checking one level deeper: {skill}.
reasons.probe_passed: Probe passed, so the gap isn't in {skill}.
reasons.gap_found: The gap is {skill}. Teaching it with a worked example.
reasons.gap_taught: Gap taught. Back to the {skill} problem that showed it.
reasons.back_to_problem: Back to the {skill} problem from before.
reasons.slip_repair: That slip has a repair puzzle. Practising the one move in {skill}.
reasons.fix_check: A fresh {skill} problem, to check the fix holds.
reasons.solved: Solved, every line valid. Evidence for {skill}.
reasons.three_misses: Three misses on one {skill} problem. Suggesting a pause.
reasons.confidence: An easier {skill} problem, to rebuild confidence.
reasons.calibrate: Asking how sure before confirming the {skill} answer, to compare confidence with the result.
reasons.key_step: Asking which step was the key one in {skill}, after teaching it.
reasons.calibrated: Certain and right in {skill}: confidence matches the result.
reasons.underconfident: Right in {skill}, but less than certain. Building trust in the method.
reasons.key_step_noted: Noted which step they see as the key one in {skill}.

hypotheses.gap_in_skill: Prerequisites solid. The gap is in {skill} itself.
